newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bancomer renews $500 mln commercial paper.
newsitem.headline: Bancomer renews $500 mln commercial paper.

text.p: Mexico's second-largest commercial bank, Bancomer, said on Tuesday that it had renewed its commercial paper program worth $500 million for one additional year.
The program was syndicated in the United States by Bank of America, Bancomer said in a statement.

Bank of America-Mexico Financial Institutions Director Luis Montiel Estrada said that the bank had initially decided to renew the program for $300 million, but that demand for the paper was greater than anticipated from foreign commerical banks.
The program has received a rating of A1+ from Standard & Poor's and P1 from Moody's Investor Services, Bancomer said.
An assistant director-general for Bancomer, Mario Laborin Gomez, said that the program would allow the bank to diversify its sources of funding in dollars at a competitive cost.
The bank said the paper is backed a letter of credit from Bank of Montreal.
The placing agents are BA Securities, a subsidiary of BankAmerica Corp, Merrill Lynch Money Markets Inc, and Chase Securities Inc.
BA Securities in New York syndicated the program between 34 foreign banks in 13 different countries.
